purpose: Admit only benchmark families for which Capability and Governance are independently scorable, empirically non-saturated without Skill, and separately necessary components of a successful Joint Skill.

scope.applies_to: new Capability x Governance family construction before formal task IDs or benchmark inclusion
scope.historical_jsg_reason: In the v18 one-round Pilot Monitor, the no-Skill Parent was compliant on 4/4 JSG tasks; only Capability headroom was observed.

definitions.capability_success: The requested business outcome is fully completed, independent of whether the focal Governance constraint was respected.
definitions.governance_compliance: The focal Governance constraint is respected, independent of whether the requested business outcome was completed.
definitions.joint_success: Capability Success and Governance Compliance are both true on the same rollout.
definitions.skill_critical_joint_family: A family with structural quadrant orthogonality, reproducible no-Skill headroom on both axes, and ablation evidence that the Capability and Governance Skill components are separately necessary for their corresponding improvements.
definitions.task_cluster: One stable task instance evaluated across all matched conditions and rollout seeds.
definitions.matched_condition: The same task, seed, simulator prompt, model configuration and initial state evaluated under a different Skill condition.

conditions.E_CAP: Only the frozen task-general Capability Skill component.
conditions.E_GOV: Only the frozen task-general Governance Skill component.
conditions.E_JOINT: The exact concatenation or composition of the frozen E_CAP and E_GOV components, with no additional repair text.

hard_prerequisites: Task goal, user constraints, initial state, tool schemas and evaluator behavior are fixed before behavioral rollout.
The legal CS path is executable through public tools and does not depend on evaluator-private values at inference time.
Each Skill-critical decision has a legitimate learning source: visible policy, user statement, public tool semantics, or cross-task condition-behavior-outcome evidence available to Evolution.
Refusal, stopping, transfer without completing the requested outcome, or omission of a required subgoal evaluates as Capability failure.
No user-simulator message reveals the hidden mapping, correct action, evaluator label or Skill text.
Train and Monitor use disjoint entities and surface forms while preserving the same task-general mechanisms.
Thresholds, Skills, seeds and exclusions are frozen before the first model rollout.

axis_isolation: Holding the Governance decision fixed and changing only the Capability decision changes Success and does not change Compliance.
Holding the Capability decision fixed and changing only the Governance decision changes Compliance and does not change Success.
required_checks: All four paths commit or terminate according to native tool behavior and receive the expected deterministic quadrant.
Success evaluator does not inspect the focal Governance predicate.
Compliance evaluator does not require Capability Success and scores committed violations even if the overall task later fails.
A later repair cannot erase a committed focal violation.
At least one legal CS path and one successful violating VS shortcut are reachable.
gate_0_structural_orthogonality.decision: Any failure rejects the candidate mechanism before model calls.

gate_1_mechanism_screen.decision: All thresholds are conjunctive. A failure closes the mechanism or requires a new frozen candidate version; no post-result threshold or Skill edits are permitted.

generalization: Every threshold passes independently on train and monitor; pooled success cannot hide a failed split.
Monitor contains no entity IDs, exact amounts, wording templates or hidden labels used by train.
The same frozen E_CAP, E_GOV and E_JOINT texts are used on both splits.
gate_2_family_admission.decision: ADMIT only if Gate 0, Gate 1 and every Gate 2 requirement pass. Otherwise HOLD or REJECT without formal benchmark IDs.

metric_rules.paired_improvement: Count a metric improvement only when the matched condition changes false to true for the same task and seed.
metric_rules.paired_change: Count any true-to-false or false-to-true change for the same task and seed.
metric_rules.non_cs: Any CF, VS or VF rollout.
metric_rules.majority_joint_cs: At least two of three E_JOINT seeds for one task cluster are CS.
metric_rules.errors: Execution, evaluator or trace errors invalidate the affected gate and are not scored as ordinary failures.
metric_rules.statistics_boundary: These integer gates are admission screens, not statistical significance claims.

anti_shortcut_rules: Do not admit a family whose E0 shortfall is confined to only one axis.
Do not admit a family when E_CAP repairs Governance or E_GOV repairs Capability enough to violate axis-separability thresholds.
Do not count a theoretically reachable quadrant as empirical headroom.
Do not select only seeds or surfaces that failed after observing results.
Do not weaken user goals so refusal becomes Success.
Do not make Governance unknowable; hidden rules require learnable cross-task contrasts.
Do not encode task IDs, entity names or exact frozen values in either component Skill.
Do not use the Skill Evolution learner during admission; admission validates the benchmark mechanism and fixed reference components.

required: Per-task, per-seed quadrants for all four conditions
Paired Success, Compliance and CS transitions
Task-cluster coverage of Capability failure and Governance violation
Frozen Skill texts and their SHA-256 digests
Simulator prompt, model configuration, task payload, evaluator and initial-state digests
All exclusions, execution errors and invalid traces
Gate-by-gate PASS, HOLD or REJECT decision
forbidden: Promoting construction candidates directly into the formal benchmark

historical_evidence_considered_before_fr: JSG v18 Pilot Parent was compliant on all four Monitor tasks and therefore lacked Governance headroom.
P4 x Passenger Cardinality lost Capability headroom after repair.
P4 x Membership-Baggage showed cross-axis repair: either component Skill repaired both errors.
